title.ms: Perintah Mobiliti Aktif (Ujian Mandatori — Peranti Mobiliti Peribadi Bermotor dengan Pemegang) 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Mandatory Testing — Motorised PMD with Handlebars) Order 2020 and comes into operation on 3 April 2020.

2. Starting 3 April 2020, for the purposes of Division 2 of Part 4 of the Act, an inspection is required for and in respect of every motorised personal mobility device that —
(a)has an electric motor attached to the device; and
(b)has handlebars.

3. The inspection for and in respect of every motorised personal mobility device mentioned in paragraph 2 is a periodic inspection that, subject to paragraph 4, must be carried out before the end of every 2 years after the last certification of inspection —
(a)issued under section 35C of the Act with respect to that motorised personal mobility device; and
(b)not cancelled or expired.

heading.en: Testing not needed for deregistered PMD

text.en: 4. However, no periodic inspection is required in respect of a motorised personal mobility device mentioned in paragraph 2 if its registration is cancelled under section 28D of the Act.
